item.title: LEE CRONIN'S THE MUMMY Trailer Is More Twisted EVIL DEAD Than Classic Universe Movie Monster
item.description: Warner Bros. and Blumhouse have released the first trailer for Lee Cronin's The Mummy, and this is more Evil Dead meets Pet Sematary than classic movie monster.

item.title: NIGHT PATROL Interview: CM Punk Breaks Down His Darkest Role Yet And Being "Waterboarded" By Blood (Exclusive)
item.description: We talk to actor and WWE Superstar CM Punk about his role in the must-see new horror movie Night Patrol, hearing from the World Heavyweight Champion about how he approached playing a villainous vampire.

item.title: BLACK PANTHER: Damson Idris Reponds To Rumors That He's Set To Play The MCU's New T'Challa
item.description: While being interviewed on the red carpet of last night's Golden Globes, Damson Idris responded to the persistent rumors that he's set to play a new take on T'Challa in the MCU...

item.title: Mystery Solved! Netflix’s Live-Action SCOOBY-DOO Series Sets April Filming Date
item.description: It looks like Netflix’s live-action Scooby-Doo series is finally gaining real momentum, with reports suggesting that filming is scheduled to begin this April.

item.title: ULTIMATE UNIVERSE FINALE #1 And More Revealed For April As Marvel's Ultimate Line Draws To A Close
item.description: This April, the final story set in Marvel's new Ultimate Universe arrives in Ultimate Universe Finale #1 along with the final issues of Ultimate Endgame and more, and we have a first look.

item.title: It's Priyanka Chopra vs. Karl Urban As Pirate Warfare Erupts In THE BLUFF
item.description: Get a first look at Priyanka Chopra Jonas as the fearsome “Bloody Mary” in Amazon’s The Bluff. The brutal, R-rated pirate thriller also stars Karl Urban.

item.title: See EDGE OF TOMORROW Through The Eye's Of The Angel Of Verdun In ALL YOU NEED IS KILL
item.description: Check out these thrilling new clips from the All You Need Is Kill anime film ahead of its theatrical release, courtesy of GKids Films.
